Sp800171AssessmentMethod.description: One of the three assessment methods SP 800-171A applies to a requirement, examine, interview or test, with the assessment objects (documents, people, processes or mechanisms) it is applied to.

requirement_method_objects.description: The assessment objects, one entry each, in the order SP 800-171A lists them, such as access control policy and procedures or system administrators.

Sp800171AssessmentMethod.title: Sp800171AssessmentMethod

Sp800171AssessmentMethodKind.description: The three assessment methods of SP 800-171A.
Sp800171AssessmentMethodKind.title: Sp800171AssessmentMethodKind

Sp800171AssessmentObjective.description: An assessment objective of SP 800-171A: one determination statement that an assessor checks, tied to the requirement or to one item of its statement.

assessed_requirement_item.description: The statement item the objective assesses, such as 03.01.01.b. Absent when the objective assesses a requirement whose statement is one piece of text.

requirement_determination.description: The determination statement: what the assessor determines is the case, such as system accounts are created in accordance with organizational policy, procedures, prerequisites, and criteria.

requirement_objective_id.description: The objective's identifier, such as A.03.01.01.b[01].

Sp800171AssessmentObjective.title: Sp800171AssessmentObjective

Sp800171Family.description: One of the seventeen families that SP 800-171 Revision 3 sorts its security requirements into, such as Access Control (03.01) or Supply Chain Risk Management (03.17).

description.description: What the family or requirement is about, in the words of whoever records it. SP 800-171 gives a family no text of its own, and a requirement's own text goes in its statement, items and discussion.

family_requirements.description: The security requirements of the family, the withdrawn ones included, in the order SP 800-171 numbers them. A knowledge bundle relates a requirement to its family with isPartOf instead.

title.description: The name SP 800-171 gives a family or a security requirement, such as Access Control or Account Management.

Sp800171Family.title: Sp800171Family

Sp800171Parameter.description: An organization-defined parameter (ODP): a value, such as a time period or a frequency, that a requirement statement leaves to the organization, with the guideline SP 800-171A gives for defining it. A few parameters are a selection among choices instead of a value.

odp_choices.description: For a selection, the choices SP 800-171 offers, in its order. A choice may itself carry an insert placeholder naming another parameter.

odp_guideline.description: The determination SP 800-171A gives for the parameter: what the organization must have defined, such as the time period for account inactivity before disabling is defined.

odp_id.description: The parameter's identifier, such as A.03.01.01.ODP[01].

odp_label.description: What kind of value the parameter takes, such as time period or frequency, or SELECTED PARAMETER VALUES for a selection.

odp_selection_count.description: How many of the choices a selection takes.

odp_usage.description: How the requirement statement names the parameter, such as organization-defined time period.

Sp800171Parameter.title: Sp800171Parameter

Sp800171Publication.description: One revision of SP 800-171 as a whole: its requirement families, each holding its security requirements, with the assessment procedures of the matching revision of SP 800-171A inside each requirement.

requirement_families.description: The requirement families, in the order SP 800-171 gives them.

sp800171_revision.description: The revision of SP 800-171 the document renders, as NIST numbers it, such as 3.

Sp800171Publication.title: Sp800171Publication

Sp800171Reference.description: A publication that SP 800-171 lists under a requirement's references, by the short name the publication gives it, with the full citation and the address NIST's catalog gives it.

cited_publication.description: The publication's short name, such as SP 800-63-3.

cited_publication_citation.description: The full citation, as the catalog's back matter gives it.

cited_publication_url.description: The publication's address, which the catalog gives as its digital object identifier at doi.org.

Sp800171Reference.title: Sp800171Reference

Sp800171Requirement.description: A security requirement of SP 800-171: a numbered, named requirement for protecting CUI, with its statement, discussion, references and source controls, the organization-defined parameters its statement leaves open, and the assessment objectives and methods SP 800-171A gives it. A requirement that Revision 3 withdrew keeps its number and says which requirements took its place.

addressed_by_requirements.description: For a withdrawn requirement, the requirements of Revision 3 that address what it required, as the catalog states them.

description.description: What the family or requirement is about, in the words of whoever records it. SP 800-171 gives a family no text of its own, and a requirement's own text goes in its statement, items and discussion.

incorporated_into_requirements.description: For a withdrawn requirement, the requirements of Revision 3 that incorporate what it required, as the catalog states them.

requirement_discussion.description: The requirement's discussion: SP 800-171's explanation of what the requirement means and how it relates to other requirements.

requirement_items.description: The lettered items of the requirement statement, in order, each with its numbered items where it has them. A requirement has either these or a statement, never both.

requirement_methods.description: The assessment methods SP 800-171A gives the requirement, each with the objects it is applied to.

requirement_objectives.description: The assessment objectives SP 800-171A gives the requirement: the determination statements an assessor checks.

requirement_parameters.description: The organization-defined parameters the requirement statement leaves to the organization, in the order SP 800-171A numbers them.

requirement_references.description: The publications SP 800-171 lists under the requirement's references, each with its citation and address as the catalog gives them.

requirement_statement.description: The requirement statement when SP 800-171 writes it as one piece of text and not as lettered items. The catalog marks an organization-defined parameter in the text with an insert placeholder that names the parameter.

requirement_status.description: Withdrawn when Revision 3 withdrew the requirement. A requirement with no status is in force.

source_controls.description: The controls of SP 800-53 Revision 5 the requirement is drawn from, by their identifiers, as the catalog lists them among the requirement's references. The identifier is data; the schema maps nothing to a model of SP 800-53.

title.description: The name SP 800-171 gives a family or a security requirement, such as Access Control or Account Management.

Sp800171Requirement.title: Sp800171Requirement

Sp800171RequirementItem.description: One item of a requirement statement: a lettered item such as 03.01.01.a, or a numbered item under a lettered one such as 03.01.01.c.01.

requirement_item_text.description: What the item requires. The catalog marks an organization-defined parameter in the text with an insert placeholder that names the parameter.

requirement_subitems.description: The numbered items under a lettered item, in order.

Sp800171RequirementItem.title: Sp800171RequirementItem

Sp800171RequirementStatus.description: The one status SP 800-171 Revision 3 states for a requirement. A requirement in force carries none.
Sp800171RequirementStatus.title: Sp800171RequirementStatus

Sp800171SelectionCount.description: How many choices a selection parameter takes, as OSCAL states it.
Sp800171SelectionCount.title: Sp800171SelectionCount

description: One revision of SP 800-171 as a whole: its requirement families, each holding its security requirements, with the assessment procedures of the matching revision of SP 800-171A inside each requirement.

requirement_families.description: The requirement families, in the order SP 800-171 gives them.

sp800171_revision.description: The revision of SP 800-171 the document renders, as NIST numbers it, such as 3.

title: nist_sp_800_171
